Eye care adds a warm light palette, a warm "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"dark palette, and an automatic scheme without a global sepia filter or image transform."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Four operating modes:** `off`, `auto`, `light`, and `dark`.
- **Three warmth levels:** `soft`, `"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"balanced`, and `warm`.
- **Six concrete themes** registered through the official ThemeService.
- **R"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eal semantic tokens** for backgrounds, text, borders, buttons, sidebar, bubbles, inputs, code blocks"},{"id":"p8s4","text":", scrollbars, and Shiki colors.
- **Native Appearance stays authoritative:** choosing Light, Dark, o"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"r System turns eye care off and keeps that newly selected theme.
- **Loopback persistence** stores t"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"he selection in Host settings; remote browsers keep the selection in the current process."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The screenshots above show the General settings row in warm day mode and warm night mode. Day and Ni"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ght are explicit; Auto follows `prefers-color-scheme` at the selected warmth. The row also renders a"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"n `aria-live` status and keyboard-visible focus states."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Install the public npm package into the Web profile:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For local development, replace the package name with the checkout's absolute path or a locally packe"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"d tarball. `DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`; point it at a temporary directory to try the bundle with"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"out changing your main profiles."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Restart or start the Web UI:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Open **Settings → General → Eye care** and choose a mode and warmth."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Theme matrix"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Scheme | Soft | Balanced | Warm |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Light | `eye-care-light-soft` | `eye-care-light-balanced` | `eye-care-light-warm` |
| Dark | `eye-"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"care-dark-soft` | `eye-care-dark-balanced` | `eye-care-dark-warm` |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The Host half uses the legacy `eye-care` Settings namespace or the modern `dsh-eye-care` Config proj"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ection, and exposes the loopback-only `/eye-care` RPC route. Writes are serialized and fenced by `ex"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"pectedRevision`; a conflict re-reads the Host snapshot and retries the latest intent."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The browser half registers six palettes and injects the General-settings row. On newer hosts it uses"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" the public theme token layer so ConfigForms refreshes cannot clear the warmth. The original built-i"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"n Appearance preference is retained across reloads and restored on disable. Legacy hosts continue us"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ing registered themes. The controller removes its listeners, themes, and token layer on disposal. Re"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"mote browsers keep preferences process-local."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility and limitations"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Candidate 0.1.2 targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`; Web installation, loading, mode changes, and persistence"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" were tested, with a `0.1.5-rc.1` regression profile. Publication is pending.
- Requires a DeepSeek "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"Harness Web profile with the standard `settings`, `connection`, `locale`, `slots`, and `theme` servi"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ces.
- A native Appearance change is treated as an explicit opt-out by design.
- Remote browser sess"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ions do not persist eye care back to the Host.
- There is no global color filter; all colors come fr"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"om named semantic tokens.
